# @bolteu/clay-tailwind

Tailwind CSS v4 configuration for the Clay Design System. Provides design tokens, semantic color utilities, font utilities, and custom variants.

## Quick Start

In your main CSS file:

```css
@import "tailwindcss";
@import "@bolteu/clay-tailwind";
```

This imports semantic design tokens (light + dark mode), registers theme values, custom utilities (`bolt-font-*`, color utilities), custom variants, and global base styles (`html` text color, light/dark `color-scheme`, box-sizing reset, RTL icon mirroring, and the indeterminate `ProgressBar` sweep animation used by `@bolteu/clay-react`).

### Sourcing component libraries

Tailwind v4 automatically scans your project files to detect which utility classes are in use, but it skips `node_modules` by default. If you use a component library that relies on Tailwind classes internally (e.g. `@bolteu/clay-react`), you need to add an `@source` directive so Tailwind includes those classes in the output:

```css
@import "tailwindcss";
@import "@bolteu/clay-tailwind";
@source "../node_modules/@bolteu/clay-react/dist/**/*.js";
```

## Optional Imports

The base import (`@bolteu/clay-tailwind`) includes only semantic light/dark color tokens. Map colors, product themes, and other token sets are opt-in — import them after the base import as needed.

### Themes

#### Map colors

```css
@import "tailwindcss";
@import "@bolteu/clay-tailwind";
@import "@bolteu/clay-tailwind/themes/map";
```

#### Ember theme

```css
@import "tailwindcss";
@import "@bolteu/clay-tailwind";
@import "@bolteu/clay-tailwind/themes/ember";
```

#### Driver theme

```css
@import "tailwindcss";
@import "@bolteu/clay-tailwind";
@import "@bolteu/clay-tailwind/themes/driver";
```

Theme activation is controlled via `data-mode` and `data-theme` attributes on the root element:

```html
<!-- Light mode (default) -->
<html data-mode="light">
  ...
</html>

<!-- Dark mode -->
<html data-mode="dark">
  ...
</html>

<!-- Driver theme, light mode -->
<html data-mode="light" data-theme="driver">
  ...
</html>

<!-- Driver theme, dark mode -->
<html data-mode="dark" data-theme="driver">
  ...
</html>
```

> **Note:** Theme overrides require both `data-mode` and `data-theme` on the same element. Setting only `data-theme` without `data-mode` won't activate the theme colors.

## Full Config (for sharing)

A self-contained version of the config with all plugin-generated utilities expanded inline is available at `index-full.css`. This includes ember + driver themes and does not require JS plugins:

```css
@import "tailwindcss";
@import "@bolteu/clay-tailwind/full";
```

This is useful for sharing the full config or for environments that cannot run JS plugins.

`index-full.css` is auto-generated and not committed to git. It is built by `pnpm build` (which CI runs before publish) and included in the published package. To generate it locally:

```bash
pnpm build
```

## Package Structure

```
index.css             Main entry (semantic light/dark, theme, base styles, JS plugins for utilities)
index-full.css        Self-contained version (all themes, utilities expanded) — auto-generated by `pnpm build`
plugin/
  colors.js           Auto-discovers --color-* tokens, generates text/bg/border/placeholder/caret utilities
  fonts.js            Parses fonts.css, generates bolt-font-* utilities + base HTML font styles
themes/               Convenience bundles for theme/map token imports
  driver.css          Driver theme (light + dark + static)
  ember.css           Ember theme (light + dark)
  map.css             Map colors (light + dark)
token-css/            Design token CSS files (synced from @bolteu/design-tokens)
scripts/
  generate-full.ts    Generates index-full.css from plugins
  sync-design-token-css.ts  Syncs token CSS files from @bolteu/design-tokens
```

## Token CSS Files

Theme bundles under `@bolteu/clay-tailwind/themes/*` are the recommended way to import themes. Individual design token CSS files are still available under `@bolteu/clay-tailwind/token-css/*` for granular control.
